description: Cash-on-cash return of a rental: yearly cash flow after principal and interest divided by the cash put into the deal, with the payback period in years. The hard part is the denominator: cash invested is the down payment plus closing costs, points, lender fees and repairs paid in cash, and leaving any of them out inflates the return. Send annual_cash_flow (after the mortgage, negative when the property loses money) and cash_invested. A negative cash flow is computed and flagged rather than refused; the payback period is null when cash flow is not positive.

annual_cash_flow.description: Cash flow per year after the mortgage, e.g. 6000 (negative when it loses money)

cash_invested.description: Cash put in: down payment, closing costs, points, repairs paid in cash, e.g. 80000

name: compute_cash_on_cash
title: Cash-on-cash return
